name: Uniform collapse (cylindrical)
blurb: Gas (gamma = 5/3) falling toward the axis of an axisymmetric (R, z) run at a speed proportional to R, u = -R, so that all of it would reach the axis at t = 1. It stays uniform, with no shock: its density grows as (1 - t)^-2. The open outer face cannot push gas in as the exact solution would, and a rarefaction runs in from it at the sound speed: the box reaches out to r = 3 so that it stays outside r = 0.9 (0.26 in the planar box) by t = 0.5.
